segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making the time. I had you down for 38 seats today, with the training package starting the week of May 12. Is that still the right scope?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Pretty close. We actually need 42 seats now. Finance added four regional managers, but they won't be heavy users.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 42 total. The plan we discussed covers all named users the same way, so that puts the annual subscription at $31,080. Implementation stays at $4,200, one-time.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And billing, can you do net 45? Our AP run is on the 10th and 25th, and net 30 gets messy.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, net 45 is fine on this package. First invoice would go out on the contract start date, May 1, and then annually after that unless you prefer quarterly.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Annual is better. We just need the PO number on the invoice. It’ll be PO-78419.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect, I'll include PO-78419. For go-live, you had said June 3. With training May 13 and 15, that still lines up. We’ll need your admin list by May 6.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. I can send the admin names Friday. On the contract, is it a one-year initial term or are you asking for two?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: One-year initial term, May 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027. Renewal is annual after that, and we’ll set a review 60 days before the end date so you have time for budget planning.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Send the order form with the 42 seats, net 45, and the June 3 go-live. If legal doesn’t have any redlines, I can sign by Tuesday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it over this afternoon with the pricing sheet attached, and I’ll copy your procurement inbox like you requested.
